message.content: {"stem":"A change to a payment retry path replaces `let key = OperationKey::new();` with `let key = original.key.clone();` before calling `client.charge(amount, key).await?`. After a timeout, why is reusing the original operation key the correct behavior?","options":["It lets the payment provider recognize the retry as the same operation, so the card is not charged twice if the first attempt actually succeeded.","It makes the retry faster because the provider skips validating the card when the key has been seen before.","It guarantees that the retry will succeed, because the provider only rejects requests that carry a brand-new key."],"answer_key":"A"}
